original_card.question: Does one explicit extension of the connector alphabet offer a favorable completed budget?
methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.
Prove a target-specific bound after adding one specified operation family.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free.

first_step.inspect: Reproduce the 945-pairing control, then read Exact interface to list the allowed calls.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Add exactly one legally priced operation and test a tiny dirty-input instance before enumerating larger cases.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Keeping the alphabet and only increasing the source count; record this as a changed assignment.

actual_scope: Scalable minimum-map-call universal F2 dirty connector: n>=4, n-3 roots, paid one-way star shears, stable source ports and root-zero readouts; exact arbitrary-frame two-root boundary; fixed-z0 bidirectional five-source eight-transfer optimum.
scope_change_reason: The user requested substantial expansion of the reviewed five-source result. More dirty roots and paid transfers attain minimum B and A counts simultaneously. The one-root extra-readout family already attains minimum B calls alone; this revised scope compares fully charged readout/shear/row tradeoffs rather than claiming a new minimum-source-call capability.
bottleneck_link: The connector can replace extra complete output readouts with paid root transfers and hosting. The dense-B/sparse-A resident backend shows a scoped improvement against a one-root extra-readout comparator with the same B count; no selected-supplier caller or new kappa is established.
stop_rule: Finish a constructive family, sharp scoped root obstruction, full invoices and meaningful replay/controls. Do not pursue sibling two-root extra-source/weighted searches, reframe a failed screen as a theorem, or post/push/submit without approval.
evidence: All-n star and two-root boundary unchanged. EXPECTED.json now includes the one-root extra-readout family through n10, independent subset-DP/pair-BFS agreement,460 forward/inverse dense cases,all original704 controls plus336 new extra-readout controls,positive neutral readout/odd-source fixtures,and61 exact readout-volume checks. Native t8 control executes the census path on105 legal pairings and detects1 universal.
author: Conor Holdsworth with OpenAI Codex and Anthropic Claude assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in discovery, mathematics, implementation, verification and writing; three OpenAI gpt-6-luna agents (tool name Luna, xhigh reasoning) handled distinct interface, obstruction and backend questions. Anthropic Claude supplied AI-assisted independent review, the stronger extra-readout comparator, performance/attribution corrections and review memory notes; exact Claude model not recorded. No independent human review or proof-assistant verification claimed.

open_questions.question: Can a real recursive caller expose this product batch with reservable dirty roots and stable complete ports?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Only an actual caller and fully paid adoption inequality can translate the local map-call gain into supplier progress.
open_questions.first_step: Pin one caller, extract exact B/A roles and ownership, then compare C_star with both C_extra and C_gray, including complete ports, preparation, control and rows.
open_questions.blocked_by: No selected-supplier caller with this universal product-mask interface has been identified.

open_questions.question: Can n>=7 attain minimum map calls with fewer than n-3 dirty roots?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A lower root requirement would reduce hosting and extend adoption; only the six-source minimum of three roots is settled.
open_questions.first_step: Seek a seven-source three-root word in an explicitly bounded axis/frame domain; synthesize and physically replay every priced transfer for a positive candidate.
open_questions.blocked_by: The bounded favorable screen found no universal word; this is not an exclusion.

open_questions.why_it_matters: Resident RAM counts and timings do not determine the project model tape cost.

open_questions.blocked_by: No concrete caller/head layout is pinned.

additional_review_adapter.method: Local adaptation of reviewer physical-row census: all64 direction words,8008 placements,945 canonical words, fixedB/Aport0, actual root/source restoration filter; identical legal count and all histogram bins. No normalized axes or predefined identity words.

backend.fixture: Five arbitrary dense F2 factors per B, each balanced dirty echo28 leaves/3 private rows; A has2 supports per output entry. Same dirty source/output/root/private rows and shared coefficient tables.
backend.timing_order: Alternate star/baseline and baseline/star, seven trials. The default comparator is extra; gray is secondary. Initialization, validation and resets are outside execution timing and reported separately.
backend.failure_controls: 13 revised native cases reject: extra A/B omission and label changes,unknown opcode,bad/overflow index,unknown/misclassified/missing baseline mode,bad numeric n/width,and negative seed. Star/Gray retain exactly-two readout contracts; the extra comparator sums all even readouts with exact formal output checks.
backend.measurement_guard: A volatile checksum consumes timed row mutations outside the measured interval; one additional scalar diagnostic word, not a clean connector row.
